title: ID0419259-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P8 170001007] molten copper on DC PIN.
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
There is an impact and molten copper on one of the DC PIN. Do you consider that this represents a safety hazard ? If so let me know and I will disable this outlet.
